Sandbox_CookieExpress_VehicleSearchRadiu: The slip tries 2, 3 and 1 tiles in front of the player first (like Kuraya), then looks around up to this distance. Default 3.
Sandbox_CookieExpress_VehicleBlockWater_: The square the car is placed on must not be water.
Sandbox_CookieExpress_VehicleBlockBuildi: The square the car is placed on must be outdoors (like Kuraya); the player can stand anywhere. Turn off to allow garages.
Sandbox_CookieExpress_VehicleBlockVehicl: Vehicle slip: not on other vehicles
The square the car is placed on must not already have a car. Cars spawned on top of each other get thrown around and damaged. Keep this on.
Sandbox_CookieExpress_VehicleBlockObstac: Vehicle slip: needs an area free of objects
Off: grass, bushes, trees, fences and furniture are ignored. On: the area below around the car must be free of them. Walls / solid squares are never used anyway.
Sandbox_CookieExpress_VehicleClearWidth_: Only used when the option above is on. Use odd numbers. A car is about 3 wide.
Sandbox_CookieExpress_VehicleClearLength: Only used when the option above is on. Use odd numbers. A car is about 7 long.
